title: PinkLifeLine: AI-Powered Breast Cancer Early Detection Platform
description: Enterprise digital health ecosystem and deep learning framework for early breast cancer detection using longitudinal spatiotemporal LED imaging and mammogram analysis. Architected microservices with Spring Boot, React, WebSocket, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GCP.
presented_in: Startup Bangladesh & Johns Hopkins Design Competition
keywords: Medical AI, Deep Learning, Spring Boot, React, Cloud Architecture, Digital Health

title: Speakio: AI-Powered Multi-Language Learning Platform
description: Adaptive multi-language educational platform leveraging generative AI for dynamic lesson synthesis, interactive speech exercises, and real-time pronunciation feedback. Engineered front-end architecture and gamified progression mechanics.
keywords: Generative AI, NLP, React, Language Learning, Speech Evaluation

title: Plastic4Perks: Gamified Plastic Recycling with Carbon Tracking
description: Sustainability tech ecosystem integrating educational arcade games with QR-based smart plastic collection kiosks. Tracks individual carbon offset metrics, incentivizes recycling through digital rewards, and visualizes lifecycle carbon savings.
keywords: Sustainability, Gamification, React, Pygame, QR Verification, Carbon Footprint

title: QuickSolve: Decentralized AI Complaint Management System
description: Blockchain-backed dispute and grievance resolution platform utilizing smart contracts and automated NLP metadata analysis for transparent routing, tamper-proof audit trails, and rapid decentralized escalation.
keywords: Blockchain, Smart Contracts, NLP, Node.js, React, Decentralized Systems

title: GreenBlox: Blockchain-Enabled Carbon Credit Market with XGBoost
description: Decentralized carbon credit trading marketplace built on Celo with IoT telemetry integration. Implemented XGBoost predictive models for solar irradiance forecasting and automated verification of solar plant carbon offsets.
keywords: Climate Tech, Celo Blockchain, XGBoost, IoT Telemetry, Carbon Credits

title: NeoScreenix: Smart AI System for Early Breast Cancer Screening
description: Grand Prize winning solution at the 2025 Johns Hopkins Healthcare Design Competition. Combines non-invasive portable optical sensors with deep convolutional neural networks for accessible early breast tumor localization.
keywords: Clinical AI, Optical Imaging, Global Health, Biomedical Hardware

title: CBRS Multi-Platform Stream Parser & LoRA Engine
description: High-throughput multilingual NLP stream filter and parser fine-tuned on Llama-3.2-3B via LoRA, achieving 99% filtering accuracy and 35X token efficiency for urgent life-critical blood donation requests on social media.
keywords: LLMs, LoRA Fine-Tuning, Stream Processing, Multilingual NLP, Social Computing

title: MedCAR Clinical Multi-Agent Reasoner & Conflict Resolver
description: Autonomous clinical AI multi-agent orchestration architecture featuring neural entailment conflict detection, Graph-Based Anatomical Consistency Learning (GACL), and bipolar weighted argumentation over 503 multimodal chest X-ray cases.
presented_in: International Conference on AI in Healthcare 2025
keywords: Multi-Agent Systems, Medical AI, Conflict Resolution, Knowledge Graphs

title: ContiFuse-MM: Continuous-Time Multimodal ICU Analytics
description: Continuous-time neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework integrating asynchronous EHR telemetry with chest radiographs from MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR for short-horizon cardiac dysrhythmia mortality prediction with SHAP biomarker discovery.
presented_in: National University of Singapore (SRI) & NeurIPS Workshops
keywords: Neural ODEs, Multimodal Fusion, ICU Telemetry, SHAP Biomarkers, Critical Care

title: AgroLink: AI-Driven Livestock Health & Weight Estimation
description: AI-based livestock healthcare and non-contact body weight estimation platform using Seg2Reg-Net Attention U-Net regression, awarded BUET UIHP Cohort-5 seed funding by RISE BUET.
keywords: Computer Vision, Attention U-Net, Explainable AI, AgriTech
